column1: # Schedule RC-R Part I -- Regulatory Capital.
# Two things about this schedule are easy to get wrong
# 1. THE BASEL I -> BASEL III CHANGE IS A PREFIX CHANGE. The same MDRM item codes carry
#    the same concepts on either side
#    A variable pointed at either one alone goes blank for half the panel. The base items
#    below are era-suffixed and the derived series stitch them.
# 2. THE REPORTED RATIOS ARE CONFIDENTIAL FROM 2015Q1. RCOA7204 / 7205 / 7206 and
#    RCOAP793 have ~98% coverage but every cell is the literal string "CONF". The ratios
#    are therefore COMPUTED from the published amounts
#    The pre-2015 reported ratios are kept as *_reported_baselI so the computed series
#    can be validated against them in the overlap.
# Part II -- the ~740-cell risk-weighted-asset grid -- is not covered.
